summary: StrategyTracker 3350.T treasury row 2026-06-30: 43000.0 BTC, 1281283624 shares outstanding. Diluted/debt omitted (tracker-computed / currency-ambiguous) -- confirm against the linked disclosure.

BTC holdings of 43,000 confirmed across three independent sources (Metaplanet IR 2026-07-02, bitcointreasuries.net, CoinGecko) — no change needed. Shares_basic of 1,281,283,624 is confirmed post-April 2025 1:10 split. The model's shares_diluted of 700,000,000 is rejected: it is lower than basic shares, an impossible artifact of the pre-split era; Metaplanet's own methodology (per April 2026 primary IR filing) excludes unexercised SAR tranches until proceeds are received, and no sourced post-Q2 diluted count is available. The model's debt_face=0 is likely stale: as of April 2026 Metaplanet had ¥8B in zero-coupon bonds outstanding, but these instruments are serially auto-redeemed upon warrant exercises making point-in-time balances uncertain without a current TDnet filing; retained as 0 with low confidence. Class B MERCURY preferred (¥23.61B / ~$149M liquidation preference) has been added to pref_liq as it was entirely absent from the prior model. Converts list is empty because Metaplanet's bonds are straight zero-coupon instruments (no equity conversion feature); the preferred's ¥1,000 conversion option is captured in pref_liq.
